conclusions: All six captured Liberty corners prove same stateless positive buffer X=A, input A/output X, BU footprint and positive-unate combinational arc. Only the three 1.20/1.08/1.32 V corners are active in the parent.

Same CORE site/height and X/Y symmetry permit the same row class/orientation, but buf_8 grows from 8 to13 site columns (+2.4 um). Current free adjacent sites must be proven or native legalization must relocate movable cells.
A and X Metal1 pin shapes differ substantially; old routes/parasitics cannot establish candidate timing. Route/RC and both fresh reload guards are mandatory.
Input capacitance increases, so upstream delay and both setup/hold cones must be rechecked. Positive Boolean equivalence alone is not timing or placement acceptance.

Exact allowed target master only, same functional pin interface/footprint/site/height/origin, same legalized row orientation, valid power rails.

Preserve every other master and all connectivity; legalization may move only allowed movable cells and must retain all protected and32 SRAM placements. Require check_placement success and no extra inserted/deleted instances.
Rebuild routing/RC, compare complete setup/hold/electrical endpoints against all retained baselines, and run both fresh exported-state reloads plus ECO logic proof.
Tiny positive legal swap and negatives for wrong master/function, fixed/dont_touch, incompatible height/site, clock target, and deliberately overlapping/unlegalized placement.
